# Warlord Grokka Ironmaw

A mountain of green flesh and black iron, crowned with the tusks of rivals.

**Appearance**: 7 feet, slab muscles, iron half-helm, flail that has ended generals.

**Roleplay**: Conquers passes and holds them with terror and tribute. May parley, demand submission, or unleash the horde. Fears only disgrace.
**Hook**: Builds a camp in the canyon, demands gold/food/slaves, hunts a desecrated relic.
**Stat-ready**: AC 18, HP 93, Flail +9 (2d8+5), Reckless, Horde Commander (+2 allies in 30 ft).
